status_meanings.owner_survey_correlated: Species is visibly on the owner survey card and a written zone table supplies the ordinary class; missing conditions remain unknown.
status_meanings.source_corroborated: The stated bounded claim is supported by multiple written sources in the referenced audit; it is not in-game capture or geometry evidence.
status_meanings.source_lead: A source reports this claim; required independent verification or classification is incomplete.
status_meanings.disputed: Reviewed sources disagree or the species/area/class remains unresolved; do not treat as a verified catchable habitat.

integration_invariants: Never replace or sort/deduplicate the original wildZoneRecords arrays in place.
Preserve both same-name fixed Pyroar and Meowstic rows and their original conditions.
Do not classify ordinary membership by subtracting fixed Alpha names from the species union.
Do not authorize geometry from a source lead, disputed claim, gift, trade, mission, or scripted boss.
Unknown time, weather, floor, form, and unlock are null, not unrestricted availability.
A route approach label is not an encounter-area identity.
A survey card does not prove absence of species outside its icons.
No random session-dependent distortion becomes a permanent map point.
